name: Cheese and Onion Pasties
subtitle: Flaky pastry filled with savory cheese and onions
description: A practical vegetarian pastry with caramelized onions, sharp cheese, mustard, and a light cayenne finish.

ingredients.item: mature cheddar (or a mixture of strong hard cheeses)
plain flour plus extra for dusting

instructions.text: Rub the cold butter into the flour until the mixture resembles coarse crumbs. Stir in the cayenne pepper and mustard powder, then add enough of the beaten egg to form a dough. Knead briefly until smooth, cover, and chill while preparing the filling.

Heat the oil in a pan. Add the sliced onions and thyme leaves, and cook gently for 10 minutes until softened. Let the mixture cool, then combine it with the wholegrain mustard, spring onions, grated cheese, and remaining mustard mixture.
Preheat the oven to the recipe-specified baking temperature. Dust the work surface and roll out the chilled pastry. Cut out 12 rounds, keeping the scraps for rerolling if needed.

Place filling on one side of each pastry round, leaving a border. Brush the edges with beaten egg, fold the pastry over, and press to seal. Arrange the pasties on a baking tray and brush the tops with the remaining egg.
Bake for 25 minutes, until golden brown and the centers are firm and fully set; verify with a food thermometer that the egg-containing filling reaches 160°F.
Cool the pasties for 10 minutes before serving.
